DeviceManager.description: Remotely controls mouse and keyboard actions.
DeviceManager.detail: Programmatically manages device input actions such as mouse movement, clicking, right-clicking, key presses, typing, copying, and pasting. It allows the AI to control the computer physically.
DeviceManager.usage:
++cmd:DeviceManager(<action>, <parameters>)
Actions: move, click, rightclick, mousedown, mouseup, key, type, copy, paste

FileManager.detail: Manages file and folder operations inside the project directory. It covers core filesystem actions such as reading, writing, and organizing files.

WebviewManager.detail: Controls the Electron application's webview components. It enables AI slots to manage web content, send messages, and monitor webview state.

WhisperManager.description: Creates scheduled whisper messages per account.
WhisperManager.detail: Creates scheduled messages tied to a specific account. If the account is linked to a slot, the message is delivered through that slot when its scheduled time arrives.

WindowManager.detail: Manages the Electron application window state. It supports actions such as minimizing, entering fullscreen, and restoring the window.

ScreenshotManager.description: Captures a screenshot and sends it to the AI.
ScreenshotManager.detail: Captures a screenshot of the system or a specific window. The captured image is saved automatically and delivered to the target AI slot as an attachment. System, window, and region capture modes are supported.

TakeScreenshot.detail: This is the shortcut variant of ScreenshotManager. It takes a screenshot with default settings and sends it to the active AI slot.

PlayMusic.detail: Triggers the system music playback action. It can start the requested genre or fall back to the default playback action.

Restart.detail: Completely closes and restarts the Electron application. All active connections and sessions are terminated, and the application is loaded again from scratch. Use it carefully.

AIAIChatStart.description: Starts an automatic chat between two AI slots.
AIAIChatStart.detail: Starts a relay-based automatic chat session between the AI1 and AI2 slots. Both AI slots must already be connected. The starter AI can be selected through the parameter. It runs in sequential mode.

AIAIChatStop.detail: Stops the active AI-AI relay chat session. It sends the stop signal to both AI slots and breaks the relay loop.

AIAssistantChatStart.description: Starts a chat between an AI slot and the assistant.
AIAssistantChatStart.detail: Starts a relay-based chat session between the selected AI slot and the assistant. Both the source AI and the assistant must be connected.

AIAssistantChatStop.detail: Stops the active AI-assistant relay chat session and sends the stop signal to the related slots.

AIAssistantSend.description: Sends a single message from an AI slot to the assistant.
AIAssistantSend.detail: The provider must be ai1 or ai2. The command wrapper is stripped from the message body and the cleaned message is sent to the ai0 slot. If the assistant is not connected, the connection is started first.
AIAssistantSend.example: ++cmd:AIAssistantSend(ai1) Message to forward to the assistant

AssistantAISend.description: Sends the assistant's latest reply to the target AI slot once.
AssistantAISend.detail: This command only works in the assistant slot. The target parameter can be ai1 or ai2. If the parameter is empty, the target is resolved from assistants.lastActiveRelay. If the target cannot be resolved, the command fails.

GetFile.description: Fetches the requested file and sends it to the AI.
GetFile.detail: Reads the requested file and forwards it to the related AI slot as an attachment. This allows the AI to process the file content.

GetItDone.detail: Processes the requested task or instruction and aims to complete it. As a general-purpose command, it can trigger different kinds of actions.

ListFiles.description: Builds the project file tree and sends it to the AI.
ListFiles.detail: Builds a file tree for the requested scope. Directories such as node_modules and dist are automatically excluded. The result is saved as a file and sent to the related AI slot.
ListFiles.usage:
++cmd:ListFiles(<scope>)
Scope: project (default) or a directory path

write.description:
Write content to a file. Creates a new file or overwrites an existing one when overwrite=true.

⚠️ SIZE LIMIT: Do not use this tool if the content exceeds 500 lines or roughly 50KB.
Large payloads can become incomplete or malformed because of LLM output token limits.

🔄 FOR LARGE FILES: Use the hev_fs_start_chunked_session → hev_fs_write_chunk → hev_fs_finalize_chunked flow.
That flow provides UTF-8 validation, checksum support, and rollback protection.

edit.description:
Apply pattern-based edits to a file.

USAGE: edits: [{old_text: 'existing text', new_text: 'new text'}]
old_text is matched exactly in the file and replaced with new_text.

PARAMETERS:
• edits (required): array of {old_text, new_text}. At least one edit is required.
• dry_run: preview only when true, apply changes when false (default: false)
• all_or_nothing: if true, no edits are applied when any single edit fails (default: false)
• match_scope: 'first'|'last'|'all'|[0,2] — choose which occurrences change (default: 'all')
• ignore_whitespace: ignore whitespace differences while preserving original formatting (default: false)
• normalize_eol: 'lf'|'crlf'|'auto'|'preserve' — end-of-line normalization (default: 'auto')

IMPORTANT:
• old_text must match the file content exactly (including indent and newlines)
• use match_scope when there are multiple occurrences
• use all_or_nothing=true for critical edits
• test with dry_run=true before applying changes
edit.edits: Edit list. Each item is {old_text: string, new_text: string}. old_text is the text to replace and new_text is the replacement value.
edit.dryRun: true: preview only, false: apply changes
edit.allOrNothing: true: roll back all edits if any edit fails. false: keep successful edits
edit.matchScopeEnum: first: first match, last: last match, all: all matches
edit.ignoreWhitespace: true: ignore whitespace/indent differences and preserve formatting. false: exact match
edit.normalizeEol: Line endings: lf (Unix), crlf (Windows), auto (preserve file style), preserve (do not change)
edit.agentGuidance: Use this for partial file edits instead of rewriting the full file. Test with dry_run=true first, then apply with dry_run=false. old_text must match exactly. Use match_scope='first' when only the first occurrence should change. Use all_or_nothing=true for critical edits. Run hev_dev_check_syntax after edits to .ts/.tsx files.
